blocks.html: The data to create one or more promotions, along with custom data that's passed to the workflow's hooks.

types.name: CreatePromotionsWorkflowInput
types.description: The data to create one or more promotions, along with custom data that's passed to the workflow's hooks.

children.name: type
children.description:
The type of the promotion:

- `standard` indicates that a promotion is a standard one applied with conditions.
- `buyget` indicates that a promotion is a "Buy X get Y" promotion.

children.name: status
children.description:
The status of the promotion:

- `draft` indicates that a promotion is currently being prepared
- `active` indicates that a promotion is active
- `inactive` indicates that a promotion is no longer active

children.name: is_automatic
children.description: Whether the promotion is applied automatically.

children.name: is_tax_inclusive
children.description: Whether the promotion is tax inclusive.

children.name: limit
children.description: The maximum number of times this promotion can be used.

children.name: additional_data
children.description:
Additional data that can be passed through the `additional_data` property in HTTP requests.

Learn more in [this documentation](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/api-routes/additional-data).
